decision.contentOwner: Product; generic retry message added to the canonical pt-BR UI copy catalog
decision.authority: For a temporary session, do not claim logout succeeded when the same-origin revoke request cannot be completed. Preserve normal Identity logout behavior and existing page-owned controls. The endpoint's 503 response expires the cookie and is treated as completed revocation.
decision.behavior: A transport failure or other non-503 unsuccessful response retains the temporary session, shows an accessible generic retry message, and re-enables the control. A subsequent successful retry revokes the session and returns to the public root. Identity sessions keep the previous logout behavior. /access/manage and /admin page-owned handlers remain unchanged.
